conclusion: The surfaces are complementary, not schema-equivalent: legal-mcp packages legal analysis; the world exposes systems of record. Preserve both layers and test compositions rather than renaming vendor contracts to imply false exactness.
method: Python AST over decorated legal-mcp tools; JSON contract parse over every v3 world tool
